questions.question: The marked price of a TV is ₹50,000. The difference between a discount of 30% and two successive discounts of 25% and 6% on this deal is:
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Equivalent percentage of successive discounts 25% and 6% = 25 + 6 − (25 × 6)/100 = 29.5% Difference between 30% single discount and 29.5% successive discount = 30% − 29.5% = 0.5% Difference in amount = 0.5% of ₹50,000 ⇒ (0.5/100) × 50000 = ₹250 **∴ The correct answer is ₹250.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:** Marked Price (MP) = ₹50,000 Discount 1 = 30% Successive Discounts = 25% and 6% **Formula Used:** Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 − Discount%/100) MP ₹50,000 • Single Discount -30% SP 1 ₹35,000 • Diff = ₹250 MP ₹50,000 • -25% ₹37,500 • -6% SP 2 ₹35,250 **Calculations:** **Case 1 (Single discount of 30%):** ⇒ SP₁ = 50000 × (1 − 30/100) = 50000 × 0.70 = ₹35,000 **Case 2 (Successive discounts of 25% and 6%):** ⇒ SP₂ = 50000 × (1 − 25/100) × (1 − 6/100) ⇒ SP₂ = 50000 × 0.75 × 0.94 ⇒ SP₂ = 37500 × 0.94 = ₹35,250 **Difference:** The difference in discounts is identical to the difference in Selling Prices. ⇒ Difference = SP₂ − SP₁ ⇒ Difference = 35250 − 35000 = ₹250 **∴ The correct answer is ₹250.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Successive Discounts When a discount is given on the previously discounted price, it is called a successive discount. The equivalent discount of D₁% and D₂% is given by the formula: [D₁ + D₂ − (D₁ × D₂)/100]%. Marked Price (MP) It is the label price of an article. Any discount offered by a merchant is always calculated on the Marked Price, not on the Cost Price. Single Discount vs Successive Discount A single flat discount equal to the sum of successive discount percentages is always greater than the successive discount combined. For example, a flat 30% discount is always more beneficial to a buyer than successive discounts of 25% and 5%. 93:T128c,

questions.question: If (a)/(2)=(b)/(3)=(c)/(4)=(2a-3b+5c)/(k), then find the value of k.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

a/2 = b/3 = c/4 = ( 2a -3b + 5c ) / k 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have a/2 = b/3 = c/4 = ( 2a - 3b + 5c )/k

Let us equate first three equations with x 

⇒ a/2 = b/3 = c/4 = x 

⇒ a = 2x , b = 3x , c = 4x 

Now, put these values of a , b and c in fourth equation

⇒ 2a - 3b + 5c /k = 2 × 2x - 3 × 3x + 5 × 4x/ k = (4x - 9x + 20x) /k = 15x/k 

 Now, this equation is equal to all the three, equate with any of them,

⇒ 2x/2 = 15x/k (You can equate with any one of them, here it is equate with first one i.e. a/2)

⇒ x = 15x /k 

⇒ k = 15

**Hence, the value of k is 15.**

questions.question: A alone can complete a work in 18 days and B alone in 14 days. Starting with A, they work on alternate days. The total work will be completed in:
questions.solution:
**Given:-** A alone can complete in 18 days whereas B in 14 days,

**To find:- **Total time taken by both when they work on alternate days

**Concept used:-** work done = efficiency × time and when two people work alternatively then one work in a day other work next day.

**Calculations:- **Let** the total work = LCM(18 , 14)**

⇒Total work = 126 units

⇒Work done by A in one day = (126)/(18) = 7 units

⇒Work done by B in one day = (126)/(14) = 9 units

A and B are working on alternate days,

⇒In 2 days of working (7 + 9) units of work will be completed

⇒**Total work done by both A and B in 2 days = 16 units**

This means they will be finishing 112 units of work in 14 days

⇒On15th day 7 units will be done by A,

then, **the left work will after 15th day = 126 - (112 + 7) = 7 units**

The time taken by B to complete the 7 unit of work = (7)/(9) days

⇒Total time taken by both A and B = 15 days + (7)/(9) days = rm15(7)/(9)days

 

**.·.Time taken by A and B to complete the work alternatively is rm15(7)/(9)days**

questions.question: Atul walks 4 km at a speed of 2 km/h, runs 10 km at a speed of 6 km/h and goes by bus for another 45 km. The speed of the bus is 30 km/h. Find the average speed of Atul.
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

Walking speed = 2 km/h,

walking distance = 4 km, 

running speed = 6 km/h, 

running distance = 10 km, 

speed of bus = 30 km/h, 

distance covered by bus = 45 km

**Formula used:-**

Average speed = (Total distance travelled)/(total time taken), Distance = speed × time

**Calculations:-** 

Let the time of journey by walk, run and by bus be t₁, t₂, and t₃ respectively,

By using the **distance-speed formula**, time = (distance)/(speed)

⇒t₁=(4)/(2) = 2

⇒t₂=(10)/(6) = (5)/(3)

⇒t₃=(45)/(30) = (3)/(2)

⇒Total distance travelled by Atul = 4 + 10 + 45 = 59 km

⇒Total time taken by Atul = 2 + (5)/(3) + (3)/(2) = (31)/(6)

By using the formula of Average speed,

⇒ Average speed of Atul = (59)/(frac{31){6}} = (59×6)/(31)

⇒ Average speed of Atul = rm11(13)/(31)km/h

**.·. The average speed of Atul is rm11(13)/(31)km/h**

questions.question: The volumes of two cubes are in the ratio of 8 ∶ 27. If the volume of the larger cube is 513 cm³ more than that of the smaller cube, find the length of each side of the smaller cube.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Ratio of volume of two cubes is 8:27

Volume of the larger cube is 513 more than smaller cube

**FORMULA USED:**

Volume of a cube = a³ 

Where a = side of a cube 

**CALCULATION:**

Let us assume the volume of smaller cube be a³ 

Here, we have volume of ratio of cubes is 8 :27 

Let the volume of cubes of smaller and larger one be 8x and 27x respectively

Now, according to the given question,

Volume of larger cube = 513 + volume of smaller cube 

⇒ 27x = 513 + 8x 

⇒19x = 513 

⇒ x = 513/19 = 27 

Volume of smaller cube = 8x = 8 × 27 

But volume of smaller cube we have assumed is a³ .So, these two must be equal

⇒ a³ = 8 × 27 

⇒ a = 2 × 3 = 6 

**Hence, length of each side of the smaller cube is 6 cm.**

questions.question: A person borrowed some money on simple interest. After 5 years he returned (7)/(5) of the money to the lender. What was the rate of interest?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal = 7 : 5

Interest for 5 years = 7 − 5 = 2 units

Simple Interest % for 5 years = (2 ÷ 5) × 100 = 40%

Annual Rate of Interest = 40% ÷ 5 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time (T) = 5 years

Amount (A) = 7/5 × Principal (P)

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

Amount (A) = P + SI

 
• 
 
 
 Principal (P) = 5
 Amount (A) = 7
 

 Time (T) = 5 Years
 
 SI = 7 − 5 = 2 units

**Calculations:**

⇒ A = (7 ÷ 5)P

⇒ A ÷ P = 7 ÷ 5

⇒ Let Principal (P) = 5 units and Amount (A) = 7 units

⇒ Simple Interest (SI) = A − P = 7 − 5 = 2 units

⇒ Using formula: 2 = (5 × R × 5) ÷ 100

⇒ 2 = (25 × R) ÷ 100

⇒ 2 = R ÷ 4

⇒ R = 2 × 4 = 8%

**∴ The correct answer is 8% p.a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

Calculated only on the principal amount: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Total Amount (A)

The sum of principal and interest: A = P + SI = P × (1 + RT ÷ 100).

Rate Percentage Shortcut

If amount becomes n times the principal in T years, then R = [(n − 1) × 100] ÷ T.</p

questions.question: Sohan buys an old car for Rs. 2,47,000 and spends Rs. 18,000 on its repairs. If he sells the car for Rs. 2,78,250, his profit percentage is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Sohan buys car for Rs247000 and spend Rs18000 on its repairs

Sohan sells the car for Rs278250

**FORMULA USED:**

Profit = S.P. - C.P. 

Profit% = (Profit/C.P.) × 100 

Where, S.P. = Selling price, C.P. = Cost price 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have Cost price of old car = Rs247000 

Money spent on its repairing = Rs18000 

Total C.P. = Rs.(247000 + 18000 ) = Rs265000

Now, S.P. = Rs278250 

⇒ Profit = S.P. - C.P. = ( 278250 - 265000) = Rs13,250.

Profit% = (Profit/C.P.) × 100 

⇒ Profit% = (13250 /265000) × 100 = 5%.

**Hence his profit percentage is 5%.**

questions.question: For the past five months, a merchant has made sales of Rs. 6,435, Rs. 6,927, Rs. 6,855, Rs. 7,230 and Rs. 6,562. What amount of sales does he need in the sixth month to achieve an average sale of Rs. 6,500?
questions.solution:
**Given:-** Sales of previous 5 months are, Rs. 6,435, Rs. 6,927, Rs. 6,855, Rs. 7,230 and Rs. 6,562

**To find:-** Sale needed in 6th month to achieve average sales of Rs. 6500

**Formula used:-** Average = (Sum of observation)/(Number of observation)

**Calculations:-** Let the **sales of 6th month be Rs. x**

⇒Total sales after 6 months = 6435 + 6927 + 6855 + 7230 + 6562 + x

⇒**Total sales after 6 months = 34009**** + x**

Average after 6 months = 6500

⇒(Total sales after 6 months)/(number of months) = 6500

⇒(34009+x)/(6)=6500

⇒x = 39000 - 34009

⇒**x = 4991**

**.·.The sale of Rs. 4991 is required to achieve an average sale.**

questions.question: A number is divided by 49 leaves a remainder 9. If the same number is divided by 7, then the remainder will be :
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A number leaves a remainder 9 when divided by 49

**FORMULA USED:**

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder 

**CALCULATION:**

Let X is the number and when it is divided by 49 it gives remainder 9 and quotient Y

We know that ,

Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder ...................eq(1)

According to the question:

⇒ X = 49 ×Y + 9 

This equation can be written as:

⇒ X = 7 × (7 × Y) + 7 + 2 

⇒ X = 7 × Y' + 7 + 2 

Taking out 7 common, we get 

⇒ X = 7 (Y' + 1) + 2 

⇒ X = 7× Y'' + 2 ...................................eq(2) 

Hence, on comparing eq (1) and eq (2) we find that when the same number X is divided by 7 we get remainder as 2.

**Hence, on dividing the number by 7 the remainder is 2.**

questions.question: Rahul runs at a speed of 6 km/h in a 100-metre race. Rahul gives Bharat a start of 4 metres and still beats him by 4 seconds. Find Bharat’s speed.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Speed of Rahul in 100 metre race is 6 km/h 

Rahul gives Bharat a 4 m start and beats him by 4 seconds

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**CALCULATION:**

Speed of Rahul = 6 km/h = 6 × (5/18) = 5/3 m/s [1m/s = km/h × 5/18]

Time taken by Rahul to complete 100 m race = Distance/ Speed 

⇒ 100 /(5/3) = 60 seconds

Time taken by Bharat to complete = 60 + 4 = 64 seconds

Distance covered by Bharat = 100 - 4 = 96m

Speed of Bharat = 96/64 m/s

⇒( 96/64) × 18/5 = 5.4 km/h

** Hence, Speed of Bharat is 5.4 km/h.**

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 19, while the difference between the two numbers is 3. Find the smaller number out of these two numbers.
questions.solution:

**Concept used:- **Finding solutions of equations

**Calculations:-** Let the two numbers be **a** and **b**, where **a > b**

Sum of numbers = 19

⇒a + b = 19 --------------------(i)

Difference between numbers = 3

⇒a - b = 3 ----------------------(ii)

on subtracting the equation (ii) from (i),

⇒(a + b) - (a - b) = 19 - 3

⇒2b = 16

⇒b = 8 (smaller number)

**.·. The smaller number out of the given two numbers is 8.**
